working: For a point charge on a surface, the flux through the surface is half of the total flux. For a charge at a corner of a cube, the cube encloses 1/8 of the space around the charge, so the flux is 1/8 of the total. Thus flux from q/2 at face centre = (q/2)*(1/2)/ε0 = q/(4ε0). Flux from 2q at corner = (2q)*(1/8)/ε0 = q/(4ε0). Total flux = q/(4ε0)+q/(4ε0)=q/(2ε0). Given total flux = (nq)/(2ε0), equate: nq/(2ε0)=q/(2ε0) ⇒ n=1.
